stories.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $64K as Stocks Hit Records, Hormuz Reopening Nears
stories.summary: Bitcoin traded flat around $64,000 even as U.S. equities notched fresh records, with the S&P 500's market cap reportedly touching $70 trillion. Reports of a nearing timeline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz appeared to support broader risk appetite in stocks. Crypto price action notably lagged the equity rally.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's failure to rally alongside stocks and a de-escalating shipping/oil risk suggests it may be decoupling from the macro risk-on trade that has driven some past rallies.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin breaks out of the $64K range as equities keep setting records
Confirmation of the Hormuz reopening timeline and its effect on risk assets
questions: Why hasn't Bitcoin joined the equity rally?
How durable is the Hormuz de-escalation being reported?

stories.title: Ethereum Researchers Push to Rein In Staking; Critics Warn It Could Backfire
stories.summary: Ethereum researchers are reportedly proposing measures to curb the growth of staking on the network. Critics cited in the report argue the changes could have unintended, counterproductive consequences for the protocol.
stories.whyItMatters: Staking design underpins Ethereum's security model, validator economics, and centralization risk, so any proposed change here is consequential for the network's long-term health.
whatToWatch: Details of the specific proposal and whether it advances toward implementation
Validator and community response to critics' concerns
questions: What specific problem with current staking levels are researchers trying to solve?
What exactly could backfire if the proposal is adopted?

stories.title: US and UK Reaffirm Support for Stablecoins and Tokenization in Joint Talks
stories.summary: The US and UK reaffirmed mutual support for stablecoins and asset tokenization during joint financial regulation talks. The statement signals continued alignment between the two governments on digital-asset policy direction.
stories.whyItMatters: Coordinated US-UK positioning on stablecoins and tokenization could shape how both jurisdictions regulate issuers and market infrastructure, with knock-on effects for global stablecoin adoption.
whatToWatch: Any concrete policy or rulemaking that follows the talks
Whether other jurisdictions align with the US-UK stance
questions: What specific commitments, if any, came out of the talks beyond a supportive statement?

stories.title: Intesa Sanpaolo Cut IBIT Stake 94% in Q2, Tripled Ether ETF Holding
stories.summary: Italian bank Intesa Sanpaolo slashed its stake in BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) by 94% in the second quarter while tripling its holding in an ether ETF, as crypto prices slumped. The moves point to a sharp reallocation within the bank's crypto ETF exposure rather than a full exit from digital assets.
stories.whyItMatters: Institutional ETF holdings are a closely watched gauge of traditional-finance appetite for crypto, and a swing this large from a major European bank is a notable data point on shifting sentiment between bitcoin and ether products.
whatToWatch: Whether other institutional holders disclose similar bitcoin-to-ether rotation in upcoming filings
questions: What drove the specific rotation out of bitcoin exposure and into ether?

stories.title: Coldcard Hacker's Wallet Becomes a Graffiti Wall of Pleas and Hustles
stories.summary: The on-chain wallet linked to the hacker behind the Coldcard breach has turned into a public message board, with people sending small transactions containing pleas for a refund and other opportunistic messages. The report focuses on this public, on-chain aftermath rather than new details of the breach itself.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a reminder that hardware-wallet security incidents leave a visible, exploitable trail on-chain, and that stolen funds often become magnets for scams and social engineering long after the initial theft.
whatToWatch: Whether the hacker responds to or moves the funds
Any official update from Coldcard on the underlying breach
questions: What was the original vulnerability or incident that let the hacker obtain the funds?

stories.title: Bybit's EU Payments Arm Secures Austrian E-Money License
stories.summary: Bybit's European payments unit has obtained an e-money license in Austria, giving the exchange a regulated foothold for payment services in the EU.
stories.whyItMatters: The license adds to the patchwork of EU regulatory approvals major exchanges are assembling, potentially expanding Bybit's regulated product offerings across Europe.
whatToWatch: How Bybit uses the license to expand payment or card products in the EU
Further licensing moves by Bybit or rival exchanges in other EU states
questions: What specific services will the e-money license enable that Bybit couldn't previously offer?

stories.title: Self-Custody Is Dead. Long Live Self-Custody.
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine published a commentary arguing that the traditional notion of self-custody is being upended even as its underlying principle persists in new forms. It's an opinion/culture piece rather than a report on a specific event or incident.
stories.whyItMatters: Self-custody remains a core ideological and practical debate in bitcoin, touching on how users balance security, convenience, and control over their own keys.
questions: What specific shift in self-custody practice or tooling is the piece responding to?

stories.title: Clarity Act Stalls Over Trump Ethics Question as Warren Asks SEC to Investigate
stories.summary: The Clarity Act, crypto market-structure legislation, remains stalled amid questions about President Trump's personal ties to the crypto industry. Senator Elizabeth Warren has asked the SEC to investigate him, adding pressure to an already-stalled legislative process.
stories.whyItMatters: The Clarity Act is central to establishing clear US market-structure rules for crypto, so a stall tied to a high-profile ethics fight could delay the regulatory certainty the industry has been pushing for.
whatToWatch: Whether the SEC responds to or opens an investigation following Warren's request
Any movement on the Clarity Act in Congress
questions: What specifically is the ethics question tied to Trump that's holding up the bill?
Does the SEC have jurisdiction to act on Warren's request?

stories.title: Bitdeer Signs $4.7B Long-Term Lease to Expand AI Data Center Infrastructure
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner Bitdeer has signed a long-term data center lease valued at $4.7 billion as part of its expansion into AI infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: It's another sign of bitcoin miners diversifying into AI compute to hedge against mining economics, a trend that could reshape miners' revenue mix and capital needs.
whatToWatch: Timeline for the leased capacity coming online
Bitdeer's mix of mining vs. AI infrastructure revenue going forward
questions: Who is the counterparty on the lease, and what's the term length?

stories.title: GameStop Plans $1.4B Stock Swap Amid Bitcoin Collateral Risk
stories.summary: GameStop is planning a $1.4 billion stock swap, a move that comes as risks tied to its bitcoin holdings being used as collateral have emerged.
stories.whyItMatters: GameStop has positioned itself as a corporate bitcoin holder, so financing decisions tied to that exposure are a test case for how such treasury strategies hold up under market stress.
whatToWatch: Details of the stock swap terms once finalized
Any disclosure on the specific collateral risk referenced
questions: What exactly is the 'Bitcoin collateral risk' — is GameStop's bitcoin pledged as collateral for debt?
How does the stock swap relate to that risk?

stories.title: Bitcoin Bridge Shuts Down After AI Tools Found Bugs Too Fast
stories.summary: A bitcoin bridge project shut itself down after AI-assisted security tools were finding vulnerabilities faster than the team could address them, prompting a precautionary halt.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights both the promise and disruption of AI-driven security auditing for crypto infrastructure — tools powerful enough to overwhelm a team's ability to patch in real time.
whatToWatch: Whether the bridge relaunches after remediation
Which bugs were found and whether any were exploited before the shutdown
questions: Which bridge is this, and were any funds at risk before the shutdown?
What specific AI tooling was used to find the bugs?

stories.title: Hashdex to Shut Down Bitcoin ETF, Giving Investors Only Days to Sell
stories.summary: Hashdex is closing its Bitcoin ETF, leaving investors with a short window of just days to sell before a final, unpredictable cash-out process.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF closures can leave retail holders scrambling with limited liquidity and pricing certainty, a cautionary case for investors relying on smaller or niche crypto ETF products.
whatToWatch: The exact deadline for investors to sell before the fund's liquidation
How the final cash-out price is determined for holders who don't sell in time
questions: Why is Hashdex closing this specific fund now?
What happens to holders who miss the sell window?
